articles.title: Surjewala Criticizes Kumaraswamy's 'Doublespeak' Amid Rising Fuel Prices
articles.titleEn: Surjewala Criticizes Kumaraswamy's 'Doublespeak' Amid Rising Fuel Prices
articles.summary: Congress's Randeep Singh Surjewala criticized HD Kumaraswamy's 'land mafia' claims against Karnataka's Chief Minister as politically motivated 'doublespeak'. Meanwhile, he attacked the Centre for failing to lower fuel prices despite declining global crude rates, highlighting a significant price hike for petrol, diesel, LPG, and CNG in recent months.
